definitions.full: H7908. shekol שְׁכוֺל noun [masculine] bereavement, loss of children ; — שׁ אֵדַע ׳לֹא Isa 47:8 (|| אַלְמָנָה ), compare 47:9 ; figurative Psa 35:12 .
